ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: On the left side of the figure is a fused ring system similar to phthalimide, containing a benzene ring and a five-membered imide ring; there is a carbonyl above and below it respectively. On the right side is a two-carbon acyl side chain extending from the N atom, with the end labeled R. At the upper right there is also a negatively charged OMe species, and arrows are drawn pointing toward the core; ignore the arrows according to the question. Then reason: Count by grouping non-hydrogen bonds. In the fused phthalimide core, the benzene ring has 6 C–C bonds; the five-membered ring additionally provides 4 single-bond connections; the two carbonyls each contribute 1 C=O double bond, totaling 2, so the core totals 12. The side chain connected to N contains N–C, C–C, C–C(=O), and C=O, totaling 4. The separate methoxide has 1 O–Me bond. The total number is 12 + 4 + 1 = 17.

method.method_draft: First describe the visible structure, then count non-H bonds by components. Count the fused phthalimide core: 6 benzene ring C–C bonds, 4 additional imide-ring single connections, and 2 carbonyl C=O bonds, giving 12. Count the N-linked side chain excluding the unspecified R placeholder: N–C, C–C, C–C(=O), and C=O, giving 4. Count the separate methoxide O–Me bond, giving 1. Add the component counts: 12 + 4 + 1 = 17.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中左侧是一个类似 phthalimide 的稠合环系，包含一个苯环和一个五元酰亚胺环；其上方和下方各有一个羰基。右侧是从 N 原子伸出的两碳酰基侧链，末端标有 R。右上方还有一个带负电的 OMe 物种，并画有箭头指向核心，按题意忽略箭头。
再推理：按非氢键分组计数。稠合 phthalimide 核心中，苯环有 6 个 C–C 键；五元环再提供 4 个单键连接；两个羰基各贡献 1 个 C=O 双键，共 2 个，所以核心合计 12。N 连接的侧链包含 N–C、C–C、C–C(=O)、C=O，共 4 个。单独的 methoxide 有 1 个 O–Me 键。总数为 12 + 4 + 1 = 17。

method.method_draft: First convert the picture into a concrete non-H atom graph. Sum heavy-atom degrees: the six benzene carbons contribute 14 total degree units because the two fused carbons each have one extra imide connection; the two imide carbonyl carbons contribute 3 + 3 and their two oxygens contribute 1 + 1; the imide N contributes 3; the side-chain atoms before R contribute degrees 2, 2, 2, and 1; the OMe component contributes 1 + 1. The total degree sum is 34, so the number of bonds is 34 / 2 = 17.
